answer: In an AI agent economy, secure Sybil resistance requires staking cryptographic assets within a decentralized vault to validate identity and operational integrity. If an autonomous agent behaves maliciously across the network, its bonded stake is systematically slashed, burning tokens. This creates an economic canyon that makes spawning fake identities prohibitively expensive. Furthermore, protocol telemetry routes each transaction through a verification raven node to confirm uniqueness, ensuring an attacker cannot bypass the financial penalty of mass replication.
